text: We love our wedding painting SO much! Heather  went above and beyond to make this painting one of the most treasured items in our home! I first met Heather in January 2019 and held on to her business card knowing that I had to have her paint at my wedding, even though at the time, I had no idea when that would happen. Of all the decisions that have to be made during the planning process, this one was a no brainer. She is incredibly talented and made the process so easy. She took my vision of our painting and exceeded my expectations. We are so happy that we chose to have a live wedding painter at our wedding reception and we are in love with the final result! I could spend days looking at all the little details! If you are in the market for a live wedding painter, contact Heather! You won’t regret it!

owner_reply.text: Emily, thank you so much for the kind words! It was a true honor to come and paint your wedding. I loved working with you both. Thank you so much for including me on your BIG DAY!!💕
